note: Small Carroll County Conservation access 3 miles north of Ralston on the Middle Raccoon River, with canoe and kayak access. The sites line a short grass loop in the trees just west of the Apple Avenue bridge; the river runs behind a wooded bank to the north and west. --Claude
summary: The county's pages confirm 8 electric+water (30A) and 5 non-electric sites, pit toilet, self-registration first-come, $12 electric / $10 tent, mid-April to mid-October. Base raised from $10 to $12 (the $10 sites are tent camping). Phone 712-792-4614 confirmed. Not waterfront stands; pin OK.
flags: FEES: nightly_low 10 -> 12. The camping page labels the $10 rate 'Tent Camping' (the park page: 'Non-electric and tent camping'), so it is not a base a 23-ft motorhome can count on; the $10 stays in fees.note.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' confirmed. On NAIP (fall, low water) the Middle Raccoon's wetted channel by the campground is about 18-23 m wide inside a wider sand-bar channel (creek-sized by the ~30 m line), and the camp loop (~42.0914,-94.6296, cars visible) is separated from it on the north and west by a continuous belt of bank trees 30-40 m deep. No creekside pads.
PIN: stored 42.09136,-94.62949 is in the middle of the camp loop. OK.
